summary: English and Portuguese first-party discovery evidenced Araraquara's municipal CTMGEO cadastral program and parceling procedures. A public ArcGIS polygon layer was inspected but its official item metadata identifies Paracatu/MG; a bounded Araraquara attribute query returned no features and was rejected. No parcel geometry was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and public requests, including scope limits and the rejected wrong-city layer, are recorded in the city record's freshResearch and requestsAndEndpointChecks.
